title: Every email footer's Manage emails link opens a page that works, never "invalid or expired"

source.ref: Help center audit 2026-11-18 (marketing agency, help center auditor)

detail:
Every conversation email (a reply from the admin CRM, a leader's inbox or a Space's CRM, a first message, a batched burst, a bridged reply) ended with a Manage emails link to a bare /manage-emails with no token: the html footer and the plain-text footer in lib/comms/email-template.ts both hardcoded it. app/manage-emails/page.tsx treats a missing token like a forged one, so the reader who pressed the link in a real email saw "This link is invalid or expired." The signed link (buildManageEmailsUrl in lib/unsubscribe-tokens.ts) was only ever passed by the Studio campaign send. The Studio shell (lib/email-studio/shell.ts) has the same tokenless fallback, and it is not preview only: nurture steps and Space campaigns go to contacts keyed by address, with no profile to sign for, so their Manage emails link lands on the same page.

DONE 2026-11-18: the reply template takes the recipient's link (wrapEmailHtml, renderReplyEmail, renderCoalescedEmail, both footers) and all six senders pass one signed for the thread's member through conversationManageUrl (lib/comms/manage-emails-link.ts), from the member id the conversation row already carries, so no send makes a new query. A contact with no profile, or a signing failure, falls back to the plain link and never blocks a send. /manage-emails with no token now reads "Manage your emails" with the settings button; a link whose token does not verify still fails closed and neither state reads the database.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
